doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Melba Liston and women in instruments
summary: She says Melba was a great artist but women lack strength for certain instruments.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Melba, she was a great jazz artist. I told you I saw her. She had a good band. I mean, certain instruments I just . . . there are certain instruments I think a woman does not have the strength to play, you know what I mean? There was a weakness somewhere in the woodwinds with the orchestra, and I don‘t like female drummers. Oh, it was swinging, but it left a little something to be desired, for me.
